function_definitions.THINK: The continuing child's waking thought, action, public outcome, judgment, and prospective-intention stream.
function_definitions.DREAM: Disposable management of finite waking context; it is neither evidence nor persistent memory authority.
function_definitions.SLEEP: Noncreative compilation of independently eligible grounded child-authored experience followed by a personal LoRA write.

protected_organism_and_scientific_core.sole_parenting_route: parent_or_repetition -> waking_child_context -> child_thought -> child_action -> public_outcome -> complete_committed_child_trace -> independent_eligibility -> later_SLEEP
protected_organism_and_scientific_core.child_restatement_rule: A parent-influenced proposition is eligible only as a new complete committed proposition authored by the same continuing child and independently grounded by same-life public action or outcome under the frozen model-free support contract.
protected_organism_and_scientific_core.repetition_rule: Repetition is waking practice of repeated meaning across varied situations, not exact-string copying and not a direct or derived SLEEP input.
